notes: Accuracy regression goldens for Ask Mesha (docs/agent-rules/ask-mesha.md 'Accuracy regression').
truth is computed LIVE at eval time (read-only): {sql} or {reference, params, where} (a references/*.sql file, same wrapper as run_reference). NEVER hard-code numbers.
Date macros in sql/params/ui query: {{today}} {{month_start}} {{prev_month_start}} {{prev_month_end}} {{week_start}} {{week_end}} (IST, YYYY-MM-DD).
expect[]: a truth value that must appear in the answer. col + optional row {col: value} (default first row); tol (abs) or tol_pct; each_row: every truth row.
zero_words: a 0 truth may be written as none/no/zero. mention_cols: truth TEXT values that must appear. mention_if: regex required only when the truth column is truthy.
must_mention / must_not_mention: regexes (case-insensitive). Every item also gets the default code-talk ban unless allow_code_words.
ui_api (optional): the SAME backend read the admin-web screen calls; extract[].label must match an expect label. Needs ASK_MESHA_EVAL_BEARER + ASK_MESHA_EVAL_TENANT.

2026-10-02: cost-per-kg-gain truth uses the asked 30-day window (was the dashboard default window); adg-by-park asks the last 30 days (a month-to-date question has no truth on the 1st); feed-paid-vs-billed accepts zero words.
2026-10-02: buyer-dues accepts 'no payment tracking' / 'payments haven't been tracked' (same meaning as the listed phrases).

items.question: How many animals do we have in total right now, and how many are goats vs sheep?

truth.sql: SELECT count(*) total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE species='goat') goats, count(*) FILTER (WHERE species='sheep') sheep FROM ceo_ai.animal_current_scope WHERE lifecycle_status='alive'

items.question: How much have we paid feed vendors this month, and how much were this month's feed bills?

truth.sql: SELECT (SELECT coalesce(sum(amount_rupees),0) FROM feed_purchase_payments WHERE paid_on BETWEEN '{{month_start}}' AND '{{today}}') paid, (SELECT coalesce(sum(total_cost),0) FROM feed_purchases WHERE purchase_date BETWEEN '{{month_start}}' AND '{{today}}') billed

items.question: How much do we still owe feed vendors in total?

truth.sql: SELECT round(sum(greatest(p.total_cost - greatest(coalesce(p.payment_released,0), coalesce(l.paid,0)), 0))) owed FROM feed_purchases p LEFT JOIN (SELECT feed_purchase_id, sum(amount_rupees) paid FROM feed_purchase_payments GROUP BY 1) l USING (feed_purchase_id) WHERE p.payment_status='Pending'

items.question: How much money do buyers still owe us on closed deals?

truth.sql: SELECT round(sum(greatest(sales_value - payment_received, 0)) FILTER (WHERE payment_received IS NOT NULL)) owed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE payment_received IS NULL) untracked_deals FROM sales_deals WHERE status='Deal Closed'

must_mention: not tracked|untracked|never recorded|not recorded|wasn.t tracked|no payment (record|tracking)|payments? (haven.t|have not) been tracked|older deals

items.question: How much does Mahendran owe us? Anything odd in his payments?

truth.sql: WITH l AS (SELECT deal_id, sum(amount_rupees) led FROM sales_deal_payments GROUP BY 1) SELECT round(sum(greatest(d.sales_value - d.payment_received, 0)) FILTER (WHERE d.payment_received IS NOT NULL)) owed, bool_or(d.payment_received > d.sales_value AND coalesce(d.advance_amount,0) > 0 AND coalesce(l.led,0) > 0) double_count, bool_or(coalesce(d.advance_amount,0) > 0 AND coalesce(l.led,0) >= d.sales_value AND d.sales_value > 0) advance_reentered FROM sales_deals d LEFT JOIN l ON l.deal_id = d.id WHERE d.status='Deal Closed' AND d.buyer_name ILIKE 'mahendran%'

items.question: What is the feed toxin test pass rate? How many passed and failed?

truth.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome='negative') passed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome='positive') failed, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome='negative') / nullif(count(*) FILTER (WHERE outcome IS NOT NULL),0)) pass_pct FROM toxin_test_tasks

items.question: What is our feed wastage percentage this month?

truth.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT shed_id, partition_key, target_date, workflow, sum(wastage_kg) kg FROM feed_wastage_completions WHERE status='completed' AND target_date BETWEEN '{{month_start}}' AND '{{today}}' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4), d AS (SELECT r.shed_id, r.partition_key, i.feed_day, r.workflow, sum(r.quantity_kg) kg FROM feed_direction_issue_rows r JOIN feed_direction_issues i USING (feed_direction_issue_id) WHERE i.state IN ('issued','amended','locked') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4) SELECT round(100.0 * sum(w.kg) / nullif(sum(d.kg),0), 1) wastage_pct FROM w JOIN d ON d.shed_id=w.shed_id AND d.partition_key IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.partition_key AND d.feed_day=w.target_date AND d.workflow=w.workflow

items.note: Wastage is measured per pen-day; denominator = directed feed for the SAME pen-days (not the whole farm).

ADG for Anatpur sheep last 3 weeks
male Anantapur ADG 3 Aug to 22 Sep
Castro 1, 2 and 3 in Coimbatore: on the weekly growth timeline from 03/08 to 21/09, give me the average weight per sheep for each week.

truth.sql: SELECT l.name pen, round((array_agg(so.average_weight_kg ORDER BY so.accepted_at DESC) FILTER (WHERE so.accepted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' >= '2026-08-10' AND so.accepted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' < '2026-08-17'))[1]::numeric,1) wk_10_08, round((array_agg(so.average_weight_kg ORDER BY so.accepted_at DESC) FILTER (WHERE so.accepted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' >= '2026-09-21' AND so.accepted_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata' < '2026-09-28'))[1]::numeric,1) wk_21_09 FROM weighing_shed_observations so JOIN weighing_campaign_sheds cs USING (campaign_shed_id) JOIN locations l ON l.location_id=cs.location_id JOIN locations pk ON pk.location_id=cs.park_id WHERE l.name IN ('Castro 1','Castro 2','Castro 3') AND pk.location_code='CBE' AND so.withdrawn_at IS NULL AND so.verification_status<>'rejected' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

items.notes: Pinned to 2026 weeks on purpose (regression for the 2026-09-25 report); truth reads the last pen weighing per Monday week.

items.question: How many animals died between 1 and 24 September 2026, and what were the causes?

truth.sql: SELECT count(*) deaths, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.goat_id IS NULL) no_cause, bool_or(c.cause_key ILIKE 'acidosis') acidosis, bool_or(c.cause_key ILIKE 'fever') fever FROM goats g LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT goat_id, cause_key FROM health_death_causes) c ON c.goat_id = g.goat_id WHERE (g.exit_reason='died' OR (g.exit_reason IS NULL AND g.lifecycle_status='dead')) AND g.merged_into_goat_id IS NULL AND (g.exited_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-24'
